events.name: Australia v New Zealand — New Year's Test
events.displayTitleCompact: Australia v New Zealand — New Year's Test
events.selectedSentence: Sydney ends four trans-Tasman Tests in 31 days before Australia turns almost immediately toward a five-Test tour of India.
events.fullSpiel: The New Year's Test is both the series endpoint and the hard stop on Australia's home summer. Whatever Perth, Adelaide and Melbourne produce, Sydney resolves the four-Test arc before a short turnaround into India, making fatigue, selection depth and WTC consequence part of the final chapter.
